scope: One whole central-campus Daxi Gymnasium exterior approximation before PV, plus its two ancillary open parking canopies. Not a campus model or exact single-day survey.

features.feature: Joined lower northeast wing and higher southwest hall
features.model: Low wing depth 80; hall depth 140 normalized mm. Source-relative fit, not measured dimensions.

features.feature: Broad main roof plus narrow raised longitudinal curved cap
features.model: Main envelope 81 mm wide; cap 13 mm wide, maximum 6.5 mm rise over its end datum. Main roof shallow rise 1.5 mm. No full-width barrel.

features.feature: Open track-side arcade and upper round-column gallery
features.model: Actual open negative space before set-back backing; no painted-shadow replacement.

features.feature: Road-side closed arched glazing, upper recessed gallery and low rectangular window band
features.model: Glazed arches with transoms are closed surfaces; road base row remains behind and beyond the parking canopy.

features.feature: Two low open parking canopy strips and central aisle
features.model: Inner roof X=38..46, aisle 46..51, outer roof 51..60; Y=-99..20. Roof underside Z=12; open grade at Z=3. Exact attachment/spacing/pitch unknown; thickened posts/roof and base union are manufacturing adaptations.

features.feature: Stepped low-wing roofs and entrance canopy/steps/ramp
features.model: Shallow raised roof-level mass, no deep open court. Small equipment and sign lettering omitted; no copied signage.

features.feature: Sparse southwest end and corner glazing
features.model: No long-side arcade pasted onto southwest end; corner strips simplified.

bounded_unknowns: All exterior dimensions, heights, roof profiles, offsets and individual mullion/post spacings are photo-fit estimates.
No basement floor label, measured track-road grade difference, foundation, pool interior or full floorplan is asserted.
Later sources corroborate broad persistent topology, not unchanged fasteners, fences, gates or roof repair details.
Neutral procedural colours are not calibrated material or stone specifications.
No PV panels, payment gates, vehicles, neighboring campus buildings or hidden devices are added.
